verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only generic export/ingestion APIs (HTTP V2 ingestion, Export API, Dashboard REST API) but no documentation of a destinations/webhook catalog for streaming events onward to CRMs, ad platforms, or webhooks; a community comment even states Amplitude 'don't do a good job in sending data back to things like SFDC,' reinforcing the lack of a working outbound-destinations capability. Missing for 10: vendor documentation of a destinations/webhook integration catalog, evidence of CRM/ad-platform connectors, and any corroborating case of successful downstream streaming.
